title: Keep Your Feet Down - Part 1
premise: You ride the last car of a subway at 2:40 AM with mail carrier Otis, florist Bea and quiet teen Wren. Bea is so short her feet never reach the floor. The train stops, the doors lock, a voice says twice: keep your feet down. Black water seeps in and Bea vanishes, leaving her sunflower floating. Otis offers the rails, but the top letter in his sack is Bea's, stamped delivered, and the next one is yours. Wren says lift your feet, but her goldfish swims in the air outside its bag.
